# laravel-ssexpert (`fe-techteam/laravel-ssexpertsystem`)

> Modern, strongly-typed Laravel client SDK for the SSExpertSystem SMS & Template Gateway API (http://api.ssexpertsystem.com) with Indian TRAI DLT compliance (PEID, Templates, Sender IDs, Single & Bulk SMS, Balance queries).

## Key Information
- Package Name: `fe-techteam/laravel-ssexpertsystem`
- Packagist URL: https://packagist.org/packages/fe-techteam/laravel-ssexpertsystem
- GitHub URL: https://github.com/fe-techTeam/laravel-ssexpertsystem
- Author: Rahul Jat (https://github.com/fe-techTeam)
- PHP Compatibility: PHP >= 8.2
- Laravel Compatibility: Laravel 10.x, 11.x, 12.x, 13.x

## Installation
```bash
composer require fe-techteam/laravel-ssexpertsystem
php artisan vendor:publish --tag=ssexpert-config
```

## Environment Configuration (.env)
```env
SSEXPERT_BASE_URL=http://api.ssexpertsystem.com
SSEXPERT_API_KEY=your_api_key
SSEXPERT_CLIENT_ID=your_client_id
SSEXPERT_PEID=your_dlt_principal_entity_id
SSEXPERT_SENDER_ID=YOUR_SENDER_ID
```

## Primary API Entrypoint
The package uses a single unified facade: `FeTech\SSExpert\Facades\SSExpert`.

### 1. Send OTP SMS
```php
use FeTech\SSExpert\Facades\SSExpert;

$response = SSExpert::sendOtp('9876543210', '123456', '1107160000000000001');
if ($response->isSuccess()) {
    $messageId = $response->getMessageId();
}
```

### 2. Send Custom Transactional SMS
```php
use FeTech\SSExpert\Facades\SSExpert;
use FeTech\SSExpert\DTOs\SmsData;

$sms = new SmsData(
    mobileNumbers: '9876543210',
    message: 'Your service request ID 12345 is confirmed.',
    templateId: '1107160000000000002',
    principleEntityId: '1101554433000000000', // Optional override
    senderId: 'TESTID'                       // Optional override
);

$response = SSExpert::sms()->send($sms);
```

### 3. Send Bulk SMS Campaigns
```php
use FeTech\SSExpert\Facades\SSExpert;

// A. Pure Array (No DTOs)
$response = SSExpert::sendBulk([
    '9876543210' => 'Hello User 1, your OTP is 112233.',
    '9123456780' => 'Hello User 2, your OTP is 445566.',
], templateId: '1107160000000000001');

// B. Or with Strongly Typed DTO
use FeTech\SSExpert\DTOs\BulkSmsData;
use FeTech\SSExpert\DTOs\BulkMessageItem;

$bulk = new BulkSmsData(
    messages: [
        new BulkMessageItem('9876543210', 'Hello User 1, your OTP is 112233.'),
        new BulkMessageItem('9123456780', 'Hello User 2, your OTP is 445566.'),
    ],
    templateId: '1107160000000000001'
);

$response = SSExpert::sms()->sendBulk($bulk);
```

### 4. Check Balance & Credits
```php
use FeTech\SSExpert\Facades\SSExpert;

$credits = SSExpert::getCredits(); // float (e.g. 17935.0)
$balance = SSExpert::balance()->get();
```

### 5. DLT Template Management
```php
use FeTech\SSExpert\Facades\SSExpert;
use FeTech\SSExpert\DTOs\TemplateData;

$templates = SSExpert::template()->list();
$template = SSExpert::template()->findByDltTemplateId('1107160000000000001');
$response = SSExpert::template()->create(new TemplateData('OTP_NAME', 'Your OTP is {#var#}.', '1107160000000000001'));
```

### 6. Sender ID & Contact Groups
```php
use FeTech\SSExpert\Facades\SSExpert;

$headers = SSExpert::senderId()->list();
$groups  = SSExpert::group()->list();
```

### 7. Artisan CLI
```bash
php artisan ssexpert:balance
```
